title: Design System: Will M Nichols Photography

display.purpose: Artwork title on detail pages; one per page.

title.purpose: Series and year line under a title.

body.purpose: Descriptions, About text, italic carousel caption.

caption.purpose: Wall-label metadata values and mobile captions.

label.purpose: Nav and all quiet chrome; uppercase, tracked 0.1em, 50% Graphite at rest.

shadows.name: sheet-scrim
shadows.purpose: Mobile menu sheet overlay only; nothing else casts depth.

motion.name: nav-underline
motion.purpose: 2px underline slides up on nav hover/active.

motion.name: chrome-color
motion.purpose: Opacity rise on chrome hover (50% to 100%).

motion.name: gate-reveal
motion.purpose: Explicit image un-blurs when the visitor chooses to show it.

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Rail navigation item; whisper at rest, underline slides up on hover.
components.html: CVAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: block; overflow: hidden; padding: 8px 0 24px; font-family: neue-haas-grotesk-display, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2% / 0.5); transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -2px; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2%); transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link.ds-active { color: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2%); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link.ds-active::after { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a3a3a3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Explicit Content Badge
components.description: The one red mark in the system; qualifies a nav item or work as explicit.
components.css: .ds-badge-explicit { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; background: #dc2626; color: #fff; font-family: neue-haas-grotesk-display, sans-serif; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Wall Label
components.description: Artwork facts as label/value rows between hairlines.
components.css: .ds-wall-label { margin: 0; padding: 24px 0; border-top: 1px solid hsl(240 6% 90%); border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(240 6% 90%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; font-family: neue-haas-grotesk-display, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; gap: 16px; } .ds-row dt { color: #525252; font-weight: 500; } .ds-row dd { margin: 0; color: #171717; }

components.name: Carousel Caption
components.description: Bottom-left caption on the fullscreen home carousel.
components.css: .ds-caption { margin: 0; font-family: neue-haas-grotesk-display, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; color: #000; }

components.name: Buy Button
components.description: The one filled control: Add to cart on a print page, Checkout in the cart panel. Square, Ink on white type.
components.css: .ds-btn-buy { font-family: neue-haas-grotesk-display, sans-serif; padding: 16px 32px; background: hsl(222.2 84% 4.9%); color: hsl(0 0% 100%); border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-buy:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-buy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(222.2 84% 4.9%); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-buy:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Size Option
components.description: Variant choice as quiet Label text; the selected option takes a 2px Ink underline. Sold-out options are struck through.
components.css: .ds-options { display: flex; gap: 32px; } .ds-option { font-family: neue-haas-grotesk-display, sans-serif; padding: 0 0 4px; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2% / 0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-option:hover, .ds-option.ds-on { color: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2%); } .ds-option.ds-on { border-bottom-color: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2%); } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2%); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Print Tile Label
components.description: The single line under a print in the shop: title left, price or Sold out right. No badges, no overlay.
components.css: .ds-tile-label { font-family: neue-haas-grotesk-display, sans-serif; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; margin-top: 16px; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2% / 0.5); transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-tile-label:hover, .ds-tile-label:focus-visible { color: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2%); }

components.name: Explicit Gate Button
components.description: Sits over a blurred explicit print: a real focusable button, white ground, Label type. No modal, no focus trap.
components.css: .ds-gate { font-family: neue-haas-grotesk-display, sans-serif; display: block; padding: 12px 16px; background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2%); border: 0; border-radius: 0; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-gate span:first-child { display: block; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-gate:hover { background: hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2%); color: hsl(210 40% 98%); } .ds-gate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(222.2 47.4% 11.2%); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a gallery. The walls are white, each work hangs with room around it, and the only text is a small wall label. Everything that isn't the photograph either recedes to a 12px uppercase whisper or disappears entirely. The visitor is in the room with the work: the fullscreen home carousel fills the viewport, and navigating it means clicking the left or right half of the image itself. Nothing in the chrome competes.

The shop is the same room with a front desk. A print page is a wall label that happens to include a price and one way to buy. Controls stay invisible until they're needed. Facts (edition, size, paper, number) are stated plainly. Nothing is styled to sell.
keyCharacteristics: White ground and near-black ink, with no accent color. The only chromatic mark is the red explicit-content badge.
One typeface, Neue Haas Grotesk Display, set mostly very small and very large.
Images always at their true aspect ratio: never cropped, never watermarked.
Hairline dividers in place of boxes, and almost no radius or shadow.
Fixed left rail on desktop (256px) holding the handwritten "wmn" logotype and the nav.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: No brand color exists. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, opacity and space. Do not introduce blue links, green "in stock" chips or colored buttons.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Warning Red means explicit content. Using it for errors, sale prices or "sold out" would dilute the one signal it carries; errors use Ink with plain copy.

rules.name: The Wall Label Rule
rules.body: Facts about a work (year, medium, dimensions, edition, paper) are set in Caption, as a two-column label/value list between Hairline rules. They are never shown as chips, cards or icons.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: Anything that is chrome rather than content (nav, filters, quantity, cart, "back") uses the Label style at 50% Graphite and rises to 100% on hover or focus.

rules.name: The Room To Breathe Rule
rules.body: Space is the main material. When a layout feels empty, leave it; don't fill it.

rules.name: The Flat Wall Rule
rules.body: Content never floats. Cards, product tiles and the cart don't lift, glow or cast shadows. Panels separate from the page with a Hairline, not elevation.

dos: Do keep every image at its true aspect ratio with `object-contain`, on Gallery White or Plinth.
Do set shop controls (size selector, quantity, cart, filters) in Label style at 50% Graphite. Reserve a single filled Ink button for the one Buy action on a print page.
Do present edition, size, paper and number as a wall label: Caption type, label/value rows, Hairline rules.
Do use Hairline (1px hsl(240 6% 90%)) for every separation, and 0px corners on new elements.
Do keep sold-out works visible, quietly labeled in Label style, at the end of the list.
donts: Don't add an accent color, colored status chips, or blue or green links.
Don't use rounded cards, drop shadows, Geist, or the shadcn default button look. Those belong to the template, not this system.
Don't build product grids with ratings, "sale" or "bestseller" badges, or urgency counters.
Don't add dark mode or dark-surface panels. The site is white-ground only.
Don't crop, watermark or overlay text on a photograph, except the carousel's own caption.
Don't use Warning Red for anything except explicit content.
